summary: editable-contracts 0.0.27 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from GitHub releases into a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and uses execFileSync to run the sibling file math_init.js under the downloaded Bun binary at install time. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte single-line file beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs` and using a canonical string-array-shuffle obfuscator (function WV8StW rotating a large opaque codepoint/string array n7gIxM). The package advertises itself as a small React/mobx form-state helper (dist/editable-contracts.js, per README and src/) and has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or an obfuscated blob at the repo root; neither setup.mjs nor math_init.js is referenced by README or src/. The Bun-packaged obfuscated payload is executed under a fetched alternate runtime specifically to run code that Node-based install-time scanners will not inspect, and fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
